title: docs(service-analytics): name the dimension-label option arm by the declared `options` list
body:
Fixes #18923

Clause-②: no

## What moved

One sentence of the `dimension-labels.ts` module header. The header named the label-resolving option arm with a **type name**; the resolver in the same file keys on a **declared, non-empty `options` list**. The header now names that property.

Comment only. No behaviour, no export, no schema. `packages/spec` is **zero files** in this diff (the card cites `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` and `packages/rest/src/export-format.ts` as read-only evidence, not as a delivery surface).

## The parser lines the new wording rests on

Read on this branch's base, `31184e5daf` (`origin/main` today). All three decision points in `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dimension-labels.ts` spell **one** predicate, and it is not a type test:

```ts
// :204  OrderLabelResolver.isLabelBearing
      if (Array.isArray(meta.options) && meta.options.length > 0) return true;
// :210  OrderLabelResolver.resolveLabels — same predicate, builds the sort-key label map
      if (Array.isArray(meta.options) && meta.options.length > 0) {
// :388  resolveDimensionLabels — same predicate, the display pass (and the i18n hop)
    if (Array.isArray(meta.options) && meta.options.length > 0) {
```

The new bullet quotes that predicate verbatim, so the sentence and the code can be diffed by eye:

```
 *  - **a field that declares a non-empty `options` list** — grouped by the
 *    stored option `value` (e.g. `backlog`), but the user-facing text is the
 *    matching option `label` (e.g. `Backlog`). The condition is the declared
 *    list itself (`Array.isArray(meta.options) && meta.options.length > 0`),
 *    never the field's `type` — ...
```

Why the replacement names a property and not a longer type list, both directions taken from the card and re-read here: `options` is declared `optional` on every field in the spec field schema, so a field of any type that declares one is resolved here (a type list misses them); and a free-input `tags` field may declare none at all (a type list promises resolution it will not get).

## Control legs on today's head

All three read at the branch base `31184e5daf`, so the line numbers are `origin/main`'s (this diff adds 7 lines above them; the date arm is line 384 after it).

| reading | result |
|:---|:---|
| `grep -c "type === 'select'" dimension-labels.ts` | **0** (grep exit 1) |
| control — a pattern of the same shape that DOES hit the same file: `grep -n "type === 'date'"` | **1** hit, line 377: `if (dim.type === 'date' \|\| (meta && meta.type === 'date')) {` |
| does any test or gate pin this prose? | **no** — `grep -rl "grouped by the stored option"` over the tree returns exactly one path, the source file itself; nothing in `scripts/` or `.github/` reads this header. No verification surface was invented for a comment. |

The control leg is the point: the zero is a real zero, not a grep that cannot see `type === '...'` in this file.

Direction check before editing: the resolver is right and the prose was wrong. The prose promised resolution keyed on a type the module never reads, while the resolver's predicate matches what `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` and `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` already say ("resolution keys on the `options` list being there, not on the field's type"). So this stays a prose-alignment card; it does not re-grade into a behaviour defect.

## Changeset, and why it is not `skip-changeset`

Measured rather than assumed. `@objectstack/service-analytics` ships `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`, and after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/service-analytics...' build` the header text is present in **2** shipped files (`dist/index.d.ts`, `dist/index.d.cts`); positive control `resolveDimensionLabels` hits 4. Doc comments reach the published `.d.ts`, so an upgrading reader's editor hover changes ⇒ patch changeset (`.changeset/18923-dimension-labels-option-arm-prose.md`), same disposition as the precedent changesets that ship doc-comment-only edits.

## Verification

Run at `3ee1773cd2`, the final commit on this branch.

- Dependency closure — `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/service-analytics...' build --concurrency=2` — VERDICT `command-exit 0` (shared verify lock).
- Package tests — `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics test` — **113 test files, 2411 tests passed**.
- Package typecheck — `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics typecheck` — exit 0.
- Gate families — derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against this change set, then reconciled with `--ran`: **54 derived, 52 run green, 0 UNRUN, 2 NOT MEASURED**. The two are `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure`, both exit **3** = `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (they read built output of the whole tree; 69+ packages have no `dist/` in this worktree). Exit 3 is neither pass nor fail; CI's `Build Core` leg covers them.
- Repo-wide `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) — exit 0 in 95s, run at `3ee1773cd2`. No narrowing claimed.

## Acceptance notes

- **A second, different divergence in the same module header, deliberately not touched here.** Line 28 reads `Date / number / plain-string dimensions are no-ops.` — but the date arm at line 384 is not a no-op: it rewrites `row[dim.name]` through `formatDateBucket`, and `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` documents exactly that (`month` gives `2026-04`). History says why: the sentence arrived with the module (`98bf36f51e`) and the date arm was added later (`4a0736b2bf`) without revisiting it. It is a **different defect class** from this card's (stale-after-feature, not type-named-where-a-property-is-read), so the bounded in-place exemption does not hold and it is left for the seat to grade. Reported, not filed — dev does not file cards. Dedupe words: dimension-labels header date no-op - formatDateBucket module doc - service-analytics tsdoc stale.
- `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`'s `.describe('Static options for select/multiselect')` carries the same type-instead-of-property shape. Already recorded on the card itself as noted-not-filed for another package and seat surface; not re-raised here.
